options: <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>P</mi><mo>/</mo><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><mi>P</mi></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k = \frac{dP/dt}{P}</annotation></semantics></math>, the rate as a fraction of the amount.
<math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k</annotation></semantics></math> is a fraction of the amount, not a count of bacteria.

<math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>125</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>250</mn><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>0.12</mn><mi>t</mi></mrow></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">125 = 250e^{-0.12t}</annotation></semantics></math> gives <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>0.12</mn><mi>t</mi></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">e^{-0.12t} = \frac{1}{2}</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>ln</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><mn>0.12</mn></mfrac><mo>≈</mo><mn>5.776</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t = \frac{\ln 2}{0.12} \approx 5.776</annotation></semantics></math> hours.

<math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mn>50</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>250</mn><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>0.12</mn><mi>t</mi></mrow></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">50 = 250e^{-0.12t}</annotation></semantics></math>, so <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>0.12</mn><mi>t</mi></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>0.2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">e^{-0.12t} = 0.2</annotation></semantics></math> and <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>ln</mi><mo lspace="0" rspace="0.1667em">⁡</mo><mn>5</mn></mrow><mn>0.12</mn></mfrac><mo>≈</mo><mn>13.412</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t = \frac{\ln 5}{0.12} \approx 13.412</annotation></semantics></math> hours.

<math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>A</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dA}{dt}</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>0.12</mn><mi>A</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= -0.12A(5)</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>0.12</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>137.203</mn><mo>…</mo><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= -0.12(137.203\ldots)</annotation></semantics></math><wbr><math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mo form="infix">≈</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>16.464</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\approx -16.464</annotation></semantics></math> mg per hour: the amount falls by about 16.464 mg per hour at that moment.

For <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = y_0e^{kt}</annotation></semantics></math>, <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{dy}{dt} = ky</annotation></semantics></math>; here <math class="calc-m"><semantics><mrow><mi>k</mi><mo>=</mo><mo form="prefix" lspace="0" rspace="0">−</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">k = -2</annotation></semantics></math>.
